title: BTC four-hour-sampled log-HAR variance
claim: Daily, weekly, and monthly BTC variance components improve next-day variance forecasts over mean and persistence controls.
mechanism: Heterogeneous trading horizons create persistent variance components.
target: Next-day BTC realized variance from six four-hour returns
informationSet: Daily, weekly, and monthly lagged four-hour-sampled realized variance
primaryBaseline: Stronger of expanding mean variance and persistence

evidence.summary: The candidate beat persistence but failed the required expanding-mean comparison under QLIKE.

nextAction: Keep this coarse adaptation rejected; full HAR requires higher-frequency archival data and a separate plan.
